title: Task Priority Levels
overview: Add priority levels (High, Medium, Low) to tasks in the Task Manager application, allowing users to categorize and visually distinguish tasks by importance.

userStories.title: Priority Data Model & Default
userStories.description: Add priority field to Task interface with type 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' and default to 'medium'

userStories.title: Priority Selection on Create
userStories.description: Add priority selector to task creation form with options High, Medium, Low and default to Medium

userStories.title: Priority Visual Display
userStories.description: Show priority indicator on each task card with color-coded badges (High=Red, Medium=Yellow, Low=Gray)

userStories.title: Priority Editing
userStories.description: Allow changing priority on existing tasks via inline dropdown
